userScope: Production direction approved; implement first actual persistent operations slice, not claim whole production done.

protocol.keep: protocolVersion1 legacy start semantics and all existing result fields/guards; additive lifecycle capability/fields. Legacy start begins incident immediately.

actions.start_routine: Start one persistent run with finite population50 and existing selected scenario; ordinary journeys use same JuPedSim engine, no normal departures in this first slice.
actions.begin_incident: Zero-step atomic transition preserving active ids/positions/cohorts/doses. No reset, no newrun. All cohorts initiallyheld on onset; existing warn/release/hold actions apply.
actions.advance: One accepted physical step in current phase. Session clock monotonic; fire fields only read incident seconds.

resultFields.sessionSimTime: float seconds, same as legacy simTime
resultFields.incidentInitialDigest: string empty before onset then immutable snapshotdigest
resultFields.normalDepartedCount: int0 in this finite routine slice

protocol.initialStateDigest: Retain original session spawn digest; don't replace it at incident onset.

runtime.team: Preposition existingteams in ordinary; queue/arrival/work/ownACK; use committedsimdelta fortravel/prep, displayinterpolationcannot authorizecompletion.
runtime.stages: ordinary→incident→resolved (client Recovery). All-evacuated enters Recovery with team movement/post-response activity still available; debrief is user-opened, not forced run termination. Engine coverage exhaustion remains explicitly incomplete, not fictional safety or a gameplay failure score.
runtime.pacing: 20-30min production design. Ordinary randomonset default4-7simminutes; expose Korean 사건발생 button for author/test demand. This increment doesnotpromise full20-30min sessioncontent.
runtime.recovery: Keep run, logs, outcomes, team resources after affected population exits. New citizen demand/reopening simulation is later; do not invent safe-reopen or clinical outcomes. Actual team return/medical-request handover can remain available on accepted simulation ticks; physical fields must not be sampled or displayed as current beyond their covered incident time.

verification.physics: one actual routine step→zero-step onset→IDs/positions/doses unchanged; routine clock>120 doesn'texhaustfirefield; incidentstep>120 fails without extrapolation; preservelegacycase path.
verification.client: one compile+native ordinarypreposition→samevisualids onset→teamarrival/controlACK→crowdcase resolved/debrief. No fullsuite/CFDregen/floorregeneration.

userFailurePolicy: Continue operating and recover after inadequate response; review decisions at end. No forced game-over from poor response.
